action_label_encoding: labels are JSON strings: {"action": 5} validates; {"action": 6, "data": {"x": col, "y": row}} clicks (item then slot). First 24 labels are the banked L2 line from results/arc_loop_solve_sb26.json.
novel_mechanics_found: sb26 is a nested-frame color-sequence puzzle whose grammar deepens each level and turned out to be fully generalizable: the top legend row(s) give a color SEQUENCE; the playfield holds nested frames with 2x2 empty slots; the bottom tray holds items - SOLID tiles are consumable colors, HOLLOW tiles (X..X center) are BRANCH items. Validation (ACTION5) does a DFS: it walks the root frame slots left-to-right, consuming solid item colors; a placed item whose color matches a subframe (hollow branch item, or a solid item of the subframe color which VISIBLY turns hollow on placement) descends into that subframe first, consuming ITS slots (pre-placed solid items inside subframes COUNT in the sequence), then returns. Level-by-level escalations discovered: L5 has TWO branch items to the SAME subframe - its contents are consumed TWICE (the 9-slot legend vs 8 slots is the tell); L6 has three parallel subframes each with an in-sequence pre-placed item; L7 chains root->9-frame->e-frame with the pre-placed item at the deepest point; L8 (finale) has a branch of the ROOT ITSELF (8-hollow item) creating MUTUAL RECURSION between the two frames - the traversal stream is infinite-periodic and the two-row 12-entry legend is satisfied by its first 12 elements: root=[8,b,c,9br], 9-frame=[9,e,f,8br]. Also: placed items can be re-selected and SWAPPED by clicking a placed item then an occupied slot (used to fix a mis-assignment on L4 without any reset); clicking empty tray space is a harmless no-op; a wrong ACTION5 validation is penalty-free (nothing resets).
gotchas: The generic resolve_replay_plan returns EMPTY labels for sb26; the banked 24-label L2 line is in results/arc_loop_solve_sb26.json solution_labels.
Read the legend as the DFS-consumption sequence: single row = up to ~7 entries; two stacked rows (L8) = concatenate row A then row B for a 12-entry sequence.

Solid tray tile = consumable color; hollow tray tile = branch/descent marker (not consumed). A solid item placed in a slot turns hollow if its color matches an existing subframe - it became a branch (L4 surprise).
Pre-placed solid items inside subframes DO count in the sequence at their DFS position; hollow pre-placed boxes are branch connectives only.

Slot count vs legend length mismatch is the puzzle key: fewer slots than legend entries means some subframe is visited multiple times (multiple branch items to it, or mutual recursion with the root on the finale).
Placed items are movable: click placed item (0-outline appears) then click another slot - clicking an OCCUPIED slot SWAPS the two items. No reset needed to fix mistakes.
Wrong ACTION5 validation is penalty-free; the row-53 progress strip ticks per placement/validate but nothing observed to expire.

Click coordinates must come from the CURRENT frame render - tray item positions shift between levels (three placements silently missed once due to stale coordinates; clicks on empty tray gaps are harmless no-ops).
Item and slot clicks accept any pixel inside the tile/slot; slot 2x2 pixels or the 4x4 item body both work.
The game has exactly 8 levels; L8 validation yields GameState.WIN (full clear).
narrative: Replayed the banked 24-action L2 line, then solved all six remaining levels on essentially first attempts each (one coordinate slip and one branch-semantics mis-assignment, both fixed in-level thanks to penalty-free validation and item-swap): L3 straightforward DFS assignment; L4 revealed that a solid item matching a subframe color becomes a branch (fixed by swapping two pairs); L5 required realizing two branch items to the same subframe consume it twice; L6 was three parallel subframes with pre-placed in-sequence items; L7 a depth-3 chain; L8 the finale used mutual recursion (a root-colored branch inside the child frame) satisfying a 12-entry two-row legend, ending in GameState.WIN - the game is fully cleared.
